Truth boundary

Scores are regenerated from the current repo files and freshly rendered dist HTML on every release build. Existing-page similarity findings are advisory and require owner approval before any live change. Draft similarity is automatically repaired before approval eligibility. These local measurements do not prove live GitHub Actions, live GSC, Bing, or IndexNow until those provider workflows run after apply.

Issue groups

SEO: Duplicate title groups detected

Why it matters: Duplicate titles blur page identity for Google, LLM retrievers, and citation surfaces.

Recommended fix: Use title templates that include the literal question, scenario, comparison pair, or state/entity qualifier.

Source metric: 78 duplicate title groups

Affected pages: /boarding/can-a-boarding-barn-sell-a-horse-for-unpaid-bills/, /reference/can-a-boarding-barn-sell-a-horse-for-unpaid-bills/, /boarding/what-happens-if-a-boarder-damages-property/, /reference/what-happens-if-a-boarder-damages-property/, /boarding/what-happens-if-a-boarder-does-not-pay/, /reference/what-happens-if-a-boarder-doesn-t-pay/, /boarding/what-happens-if-a-contract-does-not-address-responsibility/, /reference/what-happens-if-a-contract-does-not-address-responsibility/, /boarding/what-happens-if-a-horse-dies-while-boarded/, /reference/what-happens-if-a-horse-dies-while-boarded/, /boarding/what-legal-documents-do-i-need-to-run-a-boarding-barn/, /reference/what-legal-documents-do-i-need-to-run-a-boarding-barn/

SEO: Duplicate meta description groups detected

Why it matters: Duplicate descriptions are warning-only but weaken page differentiation at citation scale.

Recommended fix: Generate descriptions from the page question plus unique data atom summary. Keep this warning-only unless severe.

Source metric: 4 duplicate description groups

Affected pages: /faq/what-documents-matter-most-in-a-horse-sale-dispute/, /faq/what-documents-matter-most-when-a-waiver-is-tested-after-an-injury/, /faq/what-documents-should-i-review-before-answering-a-demand-letter/, /faq/what-records-should-a-boarding-barn-keep-when-board-is-overdue/, /faq/what-terms-decide-who-pays-after-a-lease-horse-dispute/, /scenario/a-barn-is-relying-only-on-insurance-what-else-should-be-reviewed/, /scenario/a-barn-lease-does-not-say-who-handles-repairs-what-now/, /scenario/a-barn-uses-volunteers-what-legal-issues-can-come-up/, /scenario/a-barn-wants-to-remove-a-difficult-boarder-what-should-be-checked/, /scenario/a-boarder-stopped-paying-what-can-a-barn-do-next/, /scenario/am-i-overreacting-or-is-this-risky/, /scenario/can-i-back-out-of-a-horse-deal-without-getting-sued/

Page uniqueness: Rendered pages with substantial body similarity detected

Why it matters: Highly similar self-canonicalized pages can compete for the same query, dilute authority, and make index selection harder.

Recommended fix: Use the owner-review consolidation ledger to decide which existing pages should be differentiated or, in a separately approved phase, consolidated. This build does not mutate live pages.

Source metric: 344 pairs at or above 0.85 body similarity

Affected pages: /state/north-carolina/what-does-north-carolina-equine-liability-law-cover/, /state/illinois/what-does-illinois-equine-liability-law-cover/, /scenario/what-is-the-worst-case-scenario-if-i-do-nothing/, /scenario/do-people-actually-get-sued-over-horse-deals/, /leases/who-is-responsible-for-repairs-in-a-barn-lease/, /leases/what-should-be-included-in-a-barn-lease/, /scenario/what-if-i-already-signed-something-i-did-not-understand/, /scenario/do-people-actually-get-sued-over-horse-deals-like-this/, /reference/what-equine-legal-issues-should-someone-consider-in-what-does-north-carolina-equine-liability-law-cover/, /reference/what-equine-legal-issues-should-someone-consider-in-what-does-illinois-equine-liability-law-cover/, /reference/what-should-someone-know-about-insurance-denied-a-horse-related-claim-what-should-be-gathered/, /reference/what-should-someone-know-about-a-buyer-claims-misrepresentation-after-a-horse-sale-what-matters/

Page uniqueness: Query-intent overlap detected across rendered pages

Why it matters: Different wording can still target the same search intent and create cannibalization.

Recommended fix: Review intent-overlap clusters before approving new routes. Draft self-healing automatically differentiates new drafts; existing live pages remain owner-reviewed.

Source metric: 198 intent-overlap pairs

Affected pages: /compare/mediation-vs-litigation-in-horse-disputes/, /compare/mediation-vs-litigation-horse-disputes/, /compare/template-horse-contract-vs-custom-horse-contract/, /compare/template-contract-vs-custom-horse-contract/, /reference/how-should-someone-compare-template-horse-contract-vs-custom-horse-contract-in-an-equine-legal-situation/, /reference/how-should-someone-compare-template-contract-vs-custom-horse-contract-in-an-equine-legal-situation/, /reference/how-should-someone-compare-lease-vs-purchase-horse-in-an-equine-legal-situation/, /reference/how-should-someone-compare-horse-lease-vs-horse-purchase-in-an-equine-legal-situation/, /compare/sole-proprietor-vs-llc-for-a-horse-business/, /compare/llc-vs-sole-proprietor-horse-business/, /reference/how-should-someone-compare-sole-proprietor-vs-llc-for-a-horse-business-in-an-equine-legal-situation/, /reference/how-should-someone-compare-llc-vs-sole-proprietor-horse-business-in-an-equine-legal-situation/

Humanization: Repeated cadence / AI-sound warnings

Why it matters: Repeated page cadence weakens editorial trust and makes pages less defensible as citation-worthy content.

Recommended fix: Rewrite openings around the specific horse transaction, document, dispute, or business issue; vary sentence length and reduce generic framing.

Source metric: 193/306 drafts have cadence warnings

Affected pages: draft-insight-2026-04-25-do-i-need-a-contract-to-buy-a-horse, draft-insight-2026-04-28-when-does-ownership-legally-transfer-in-a-horse-sale, draft-insight-2026-04-29-who-is-responsible-after-a-horse-sale-is-completed, draft-insight-2026-05-01-what-happens-if-there-is-no-written-agreement-in-a-horse-sale, draft-insight-2026-05-05-what-happens-if-a-horse-becomes-lame-after-sale, draft-insight-2026-05-06-can-a-buyer-sue-after-an-as-is-horse-sale, draft-insight-2026-05-07-what-happens-if-a-horse-sale-goes-wrong, draft-insight-2026-05-09-what-if-i-bought-a-horse-without-a-contract, draft-insight-2026-05-10-horse-sale-contract-vs-bill-of-sale, draft-insight-2026-05-11-contract-vs-handshake-deal-in-a-horse-sale, draft-insight-2026-05-17-who-is-liable-during-a-horse-lease, draft-insight-2026-05-20-can-you-end-a-horse-lease-early

Editorial: Word count outside advisory band

Why it matters: Length can signal thinness or sprawl, but word count is not quality and is warning-only.

Recommended fix: Review only if the page also lacks an answer, atom, routing block, or useful links. Never block approval on word count alone.

Source metric: 5/306 drafts have word-count warnings

Affected pages: draft-whitepaper-2026-08-03-equine-business-formation, draft-whitepaper-2026-09-01-horse-lease-and-trial, draft-whitepaper-2026-10-01-horse-sale-and-purchase, draft-whitepaper-2026-11-02-intellectual-property-and-brand, draft-whitepaper-2026-12-01-liability-waivers-insurance
